tests.output:
PASS Preparation is paused before all combat and ignores repeated begin
PASS Every phase has a command boundary, repeated commit/end cannot execute twice
PASS Card costs, duplicate orders and incompatible postures enforced
PASS Manual stepping and Quick Resolve share exact outcomes across 40 seeds
PASS Formation preview never changes combat RNG or generates arrows
PASS Empty quivers cause zero arrow damage and ammo never increases
PASS Event choice is once-only and unavailable choices are rejected
PASS Guards are capped by soldiers and do not create a hero army
PASS Reserves stay out until committed; exhausted and fresh rows mix their fatigue
PASS Emergency retreat costs more than successful organized withdrawal
PASS Persistent readiness degrades across fights without ammo or supply refills
PASS Result/report/fates are cached; narrative consumes no battle RNG
PASS AI observation hides unrevealed plan and supply
PASS Siege equipment opens breaches, unavailable maneuvers stay unavailable
PASS Army and garrison readiness survive save/load; old partial saves migrate
PASS Campaign application is idempotent and preserves the pre-casualty baseline
PASS Marching costs readiness; safe-city rest recovers it without restoring casualties
PASS Narrative has >100 unique fact-bound passages and reports factual evidence
PASS Splitting and partial merging transfer weighted readiness without replenishing source
PASS Keeping a siege returns only held men, all survivors keep the cost of battle
PASS No equipment produces a siege postponement, not a fake defeat
PASS A blocked retreat cannot teleport to a distant friendly preferred city
PASS No pursuit is honored during sector collapse and after withdrawal
PASS Hard pursuit causes more losses but exposes cavalry to an actual reserve trap
PASS AI can use emergency retreat at zero command points
PASS Wave assault cannot spend absent supplies; specialized plans require their troops
PASS Campaign passes actual leader personality and abilities to tactical AI
PASS AI choices respond to personality, condition, composition and phase
PASS Report commander fate matches the cached campaign outcome
PASS Exposed skirmishers take melee losses when cavalry catches them
PASS Rapid assault counters the extra uncontested attrition volley from either side
31 battle logic groups passed

PASS Six campaign starts: valid two-candidate opportunities, capacity and state
PASS Earned keys including turn zero cannot grant twice; cooldown and bank cap
PASS One replacement per delegation, capped earned tokens, no repeated-city tokens
PASS Contract hires exactly one, deducts one-turn advance and retires the other name
PASS Invalid salaries, no funds and full capacity never create leaders or consume attempts
PASS Salary acceptance rises with offer, prestige and personality change expectations
PASS Insult ends negotiation, two ordinary refusals exhaust attempts, fixed saved threshold
PASS Pending offers freeze salary through treasury changes and save/load
PASS Old saves retain leader IDs, contracts, army references, XP and biography identity
PASS Legacy invalid candidates and duplicate offers are migrated safely
PASS Historical candidate timing, affiliation, local fallback and spoiler-free copy
PASS Rerolls persist after load; dismissed hires do not refresh offers
PASS Relationships materially change loyalty, honor cannot be bought repeatedly
PASS Assignment, rivalry, ignored requests and promises have distinct consequences
PASS Capture, valid rescue, invalid rescue and repeated fate callbacks are safe
PASS Execution records a loss without generating a fictional replacement; invalid execution does nothing
PASS Defection produces a memorial and surviving friendship becomes rivalry
PASS Specialized growth persists, grants mobility only to qualified leaders; officers stay modest
PASS Late-game treasury does not buy opportunities; repeated losses and recaptures cannot spam
PASS End-round and world-tick integration stay runnable for both scenarios
PASS Context and personality change spoken reactions; city service and scars are recorded
PASS Historical rivals link when hired later and exert political pressure
PASS Prestige adds social abilities and mentorship rather than only raw bonuses
PASS Direct event deaths have consequences once; expired opportunities never reopen
PASS Geography and political context gate recruitment and salary expectations
PASS A rest request requires a real idle friendly turn, not merely moving home
PASS Starting armies use their intended historical leaders without stealing rulers
PASS Campaign randomness is saved: new campaigns vary, reloads retain the same candidates
PASS Expanded starting empires retain viable leader loyalty and meaningful personal choices
29/29 leader tests passed
